units: <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 343:1">Sifré Deut. 343</cite> <he>לל׳ … הבימה ונשכר לו לאהד וכ׳</he> like to an advocate who stands on the platform (in court) and has been hired by a man to speak in his behalf; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 951:12">Yalk. ib. 951</cite> <he>ללאיטר … ונזכר וכ׳</he> (corr. acc.).
